title: Synology DSM OAuth and NGINX flaws
what_changed: Fixes for DSM 7.3 and 7.4 were described as due by 20 November; Synology's revised advisories (20 November) now list fixed builds for 7.3 and 7.4 and mark other versions OnGoing. Removed unsourced claims about NAS backups and ransomware from exec.
